Feature: probe

  Scenario: a proposed initiative whose fulfils names a request the queue does not hold

    And every round ends
    When the person runs `work run i1`
    Then probe report

cat > $S/test_probe.py <<'EOF'
import os
from pytest_bdd import given, then, scenarios
from tests.scenarios.conftest import *
from tests.scenarios.test_supervision import *
from tests.scenarios.supervision_world import commit_all, git, write, full

scenarios(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "probe.feature"))

@given("i1 is proposed and fulfils the missing request q9")
def missing(repo):
    write(repo, ".shop/work/i1/initiative.md", "---\nid: %s\nkind: initiative\nstatus: proposed\nfulfils: q9\n---\n" % full("initiative", "i1"))
    commit_all(repo, "i1 fulfils q9, not held")

@then("probe report")
def report(repo, context):
    d = context["done"]
    print("\nEXIT", d.returncode, "\nERR", d.stderr.strip()[-400:])
    print("STATUS", git(repo, "status", "--porcelain"))
    print("BRANCHES", git(repo, "branch", "--list"))
    print("INIT", (repo / ".shop/work/i1/initiative.md").read_text())
    print("LOG", git(repo, "log", "--format=%s", "-3"))
EOF
python3 -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n0 -s -q $S/test_probe.py -k missing --rootdir=. -c pytest.ini 2>&1 | tail -30
